top_offers.title: Founding Full Stack & AI Engineer
top_offers.why: A genuine founding role with heavy AI/LLM exposure and full-stack scope matches the cofounder, build-from-zero profile closely. Remote option softens the SF home base, and the early stage means real architectural ownership rather than incremental feature work.

top_offers.title: Founding AI Engineer
top_offers.why: Founding-level AI ownership at a mission-driven startup (simplifying immigration for skilled workers) plays well against the AI-augmented engineering focus and cofounder background. Seattle is onsite rather than Geneva-friendly, which is the main drag on the score.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer, Full Stack
top_offers.why: Strong technical overlap (TypeScript/Next.js, APIs, infra) and a real founding mandate, but the crypto-trading focus is a weaker mission fit and the NYC office setup likely means limited remote flexibility.

top_offers.title: Staff Software Engineer
top_offers.why: Platform ownership on a small, fast-moving dev-tools team lines up with the platform engineering background, though there's no confirmed AI angle and the remote policy wasn't stated anywhere in the listing.
